shortcuts.title.defaultMessage: キーボードショートカット
shortcuts.title.description: The heading of the dialog that lists the keyboard shortcuts usable on the current screen.

shortcuts.help.defaultMessage: キーボードショートカットを表示
shortcuts.help.description: The action, listed in the keyboard shortcuts dialog itself, that opens that dialog.

shortcuts.screen.description: The heading of the group of shortcuts that work anywhere on the current screen, in the keyboard shortcuts dialog.

shortcuts.close.description: The button that closes the keyboard shortcuts dialog.

shortcuts.current.description: A mark beside the heading of the group of keyboard shortcuts that act on what has focus now, in the keyboard shortcuts dialog.
